description: Reviewed NHA reasoning skills using the existing TRACE-Net Engram skill-card schema.

skill_cards.title: Direct next-higher-assembly lookup
skill_cards.description: Resolve the immediate one-hop parent assembly for a real part.
applies_when: Resolve the immediate one-hop parent assembly for a real part.
A real part identifier and an assembly-relationship intent are both present.
does_not_apply_when: The request is only a procedure, exact-location, compatibility, or approval question.
The identifier is reserved synthetic benchmark data in a production request.
skill_cards.reasoning_goal: Retrieve the nearest source-supported one-hop parent and keep higher ancestors separate.
required_first_searches: Search the real NHA relationship bundle for the exact child identifier.
Resolve the direct parent and supporting row/anchor pages.
Check for competing or scope-dependent parent candidates before allowing a direct claim.
forbidden_tunnels: Using Engram atoms or examples as source evidence.
Using the synthetic N5 overlay for a production claim.
Allowing an LLM to invent a parent, child, hierarchy hop, project, revision, or effectivity.
ranking_policy: A source-supported one-hop parent outranks a derived ancestor.
The nearest supported component group outranks a top assembly for attaching hardware.
Ambiguous candidates remain candidates until scope resolves them.

evidence_sufficiency.direct_answer_requires: Exactly one source-supported direct parent with source pages and no unresolved competing scope.
evidence_sufficiency.candidate_mode_when: Multiple candidate parents exist or a source-supported parent coexists with unresolved ambiguous alternatives.
evidence_sufficiency.guidance_mode_when: Only OCR, visual, summary, or graph guidance exists without a real source-supported relationship.

answer_mode_rules.direct_if: Exactly one source-supported direct parent with source pages and no unresolved competing scope.
answer_mode_rules.fail_closed_if: No real source-supported relationship and source page are available, or the requested scope remains unresolved.

answer_requirements: State the child and immediate parent exactly.
Cite every source page supporting the one-hop relationship.
Do not substitute a higher ancestor for the direct NHA.
For attaching parts, name the nearest supported component group.
follow_up_policy: Ask for project, configuration, effectivity, usage code, revision, or variant only when it separates candidates.
Do not ask follow-ups when exactly one source-supported direct parent exists.
positive_examples: What is the direct NHA of part 120-20970-001?
Which assembly immediately contains 120-20970-001?
Where does 120-20970-001 install in the hierarchy?
What is one level above 120-20970-001?
Which component is the attaching bolt 42952-10 directly under?
negative_examples: Query: How do I install 120-20970-001? | Not an NHA question; route to procedure retrieval.
Query: Find part 120-20970-001. | Exact identifier lookup, not an assembly relationship.
Query: Is 120-20970-001 approved for replacement? | Authority verification, not NHA reasoning.
known_failure_lessons: Never report a grandparent as the direct NHA when an intermediate supported hop exists.
Never collapse multiple parent candidates without project, configuration, effectivity, usage-code, revision, or variant context.
OCR, visual, summary, and Engram guidance cannot prove an NHA relationship without source-supported relationship evidence.

skill_cards.title: Ordered assembly ancestor chain
skill_cards.description: Return an ordered child-to-parent-to-ancestor chain without skipping supported intermediate hops.
applies_when: Return an ordered child-to-parent-to-ancestor chain without skipping supported intermediate hops.
A real part identifier and an assembly-relationship intent are both present.
does_not_apply_when: The request is only a procedure, exact-location, compatibility, or approval question.
The identifier is reserved synthetic benchmark data in a production request.
skill_cards.reasoning_goal: Traverse only source-supported direct edges in order and stop or limit the chain when any hop is ambiguous.
required_first_searches: Resolve the exact child in the real NHA relationship bundle.
Follow direct supported edges one hop at a time with a bounded depth.
Collect the supporting pages for every hop and detect cycles or conflicting parents.
forbidden_tunnels: Using Engram atoms or examples as source evidence.
Using the synthetic N5 overlay for a production claim.
Allowing an LLM to invent a parent, child, hierarchy hop, project, revision, or effectivity.
ranking_policy: A complete supported prefix of a chain outranks a speculative complete chain.
Stop at the first unresolved parent instead of jumping to a known higher assembly.

evidence_sufficiency.direct_answer_requires: Every reported hop is source-supported, ordered, acyclic, and backed by source pages.
evidence_sufficiency.candidate_mode_when: The first or any later hop has multiple candidates or missing scope.
evidence_sufficiency.guidance_mode_when: Only OCR, visual, summary, or graph guidance exists without a real source-supported relationship.

answer_mode_rules.direct_if: Every reported hop is source-supported, ordered, acyclic, and backed by source pages.
answer_mode_rules.fail_closed_if: No real source-supported relationship and source page are available, or the requested scope remains unresolved.

answer_requirements: Render the chain in exact order from requested part upward.
Identify which hop becomes uncertain, if any.
Cite pages for each supported hop.
Never infer a missing intermediate relationship from a known top assembly.
follow_up_policy: Ask for the scope field that resolves the first ambiguous hop.
Do not request unrelated manufacturer or ATA details when the ambiguity is project/revision based.
positive_examples: Show the complete assembly chain above 42952-10.
Walk me upward through the assemblies for 120-20970-001.
What are all higher assemblies above this part?
Trace the parent path from 120-29073-001 to the top assembly.
Give the ordered hierarchy above 120-34291-001.
negative_examples: Query: How do I install 120-20970-001? | Not an NHA question; route to procedure retrieval.
Query: Find part 120-20970-001. | Exact identifier lookup, not an assembly relationship.
Query: Is 120-20970-001 approved for replacement? | Authority verification, not NHA reasoning.
known_failure_lessons: Never report a grandparent as the direct NHA when an intermediate supported hop exists.
Never collapse multiple parent candidates without project, configuration, effectivity, usage-code, revision, or variant context.
OCR, visual, summary, and Engram guidance cannot prove an NHA relationship without source-supported relationship evidence.

skill_cards.title: Direct children versus lower descendants
skill_cards.description: Separate immediate one-hop children from transitive lower descendants of an assembly.
applies_when: Separate immediate one-hop children from transitive lower descendants of an assembly.
A real part identifier and an assembly-relationship intent are both present.
does_not_apply_when: The request is only a procedure, exact-location, compatibility, or approval question.
The identifier is reserved synthetic benchmark data in a production request.
skill_cards.reasoning_goal: Return direct children and transitive descendants in distinct sets, preserving edge depth and evidence.
required_first_searches: Resolve exact source-supported incoming child edges for the requested assembly.
Traverse lower descendants separately with a bounded depth.
Collect source pages and avoid duplicating direct children in the lower-descendant list.
forbidden_tunnels: Using Engram atoms or examples as source evidence.
Using the synthetic N5 overlay for a production claim.
Allowing an LLM to invent a parent, child, hierarchy hop, project, revision, or effectivity.
ranking_policy: One-hop direct children are always listed before transitive descendants.
Supported edges outrank candidate or guidance-only edges.
Do not flatten all descendants into a direct-child list.

evidence_sufficiency.direct_answer_requires: Each direct child or descendant path is composed entirely of source-supported edges with source pages.
evidence_sufficiency.candidate_mode_when: Some child edges are ambiguous or a lower path becomes scope dependent.
evidence_sufficiency.guidance_mode_when: Only OCR, visual, summary, or graph guidance exists without a real source-supported relationship.

answer_mode_rules.direct_if: Each direct child or descendant path is composed entirely of source-supported edges with source pages.
answer_mode_rules.fail_closed_if: No real source-supported relationship and source page are available, or the requested scope remains unresolved.

answer_requirements: Label direct children and lower descendants separately.
Do not count the same relationship twice.
Cite the pages supporting each reported edge or grouped set.
State when only one hierarchy level is available.
follow_up_policy: Ask whether the user wants only one level or the full bounded breakdown when unclear.
Ask for scope only when candidate child relationships require it.
positive_examples: List the direct children of assembly 120-29067-001.
Which parts sit immediately below 120-29067-001?
Show direct versus lower descendants below 120-29067-001.
Give the full breakdown under 120-29067-001 but separate one-hop components.
What subassemblies and nested parts are below 120-29067-001?
negative_examples: Query: How do I install 120-20970-001? | Not an NHA question; route to procedure retrieval.
Query: Find part 120-20970-001. | Exact identifier lookup, not an assembly relationship.
Query: Is 120-20970-001 approved for replacement? | Authority verification, not NHA reasoning.
known_failure_lessons: Never report a grandparent as the direct NHA when an intermediate supported hop exists.
Never collapse multiple parent candidates without project, configuration, effectivity, usage-code, revision, or variant context.
OCR, visual, summary, and Engram guidance cannot prove an NHA relationship without source-supported relationship evidence.

skill_cards.title: Assembly relationship evidence recovery
skill_cards.description: Recover the source pages, IPL figure, and item context that support an NHA relationship.
applies_when: Recover the source pages, IPL figure, and item context that support an NHA relationship.
A real part identifier and an assembly-relationship intent are both present.
does_not_apply_when: The request is only a procedure, exact-location, compatibility, or approval question.
The identifier is reserved synthetic benchmark data in a production request.
skill_cards.reasoning_goal: Return the exact pages and relationship context without inventing a parent claim that the source bundle does not support.
required_first_searches: Resolve the exact part relationship record in the real NHA bundle.
Return row page and anchor/figure pages in source order.
Expose relationship status and scope limits to the writer without leaking internal IDs publicly.
forbidden_tunnels: Using Engram atoms or examples as source evidence.
Using the synthetic N5 overlay for a production claim.
Allowing an LLM to invent a parent, child, hierarchy hop, project, revision, or effectivity.
ranking_policy: The IPL row page is primary relationship evidence.
Figure/anchor pages are supporting context, not replacements for the row relationship.
Ambiguous relationship pages support candidate reporting, not a chosen direct parent.

evidence_sufficiency.direct_answer_requires: The requested relationship record and at least one source page are available in the real release.
evidence_sufficiency.candidate_mode_when: Pages exist for an ambiguous candidate group but no single direct parent is source-supported in the requested scope.
evidence_sufficiency.guidance_mode_when: Only OCR, visual, summary, or graph guidance exists without a real source-supported relationship.

answer_mode_rules.direct_if: The requested relationship record and at least one source page are available in the real release.
answer_mode_rules.fail_closed_if: No real source-supported relationship and source page are available, or the requested scope remains unresolved.

answer_requirements: List source pages explicitly.
Explain whether the pages support a confirmed relationship or only candidate parents.
Keep internal relationship IDs, truth flags, and benchmark fields out of the public answer.
Do not claim that a page proves effectivity or approval unless that authority is separately present.
follow_up_policy: Ask which candidate or scope the user wants when multiple relationship records share the child.
Do not ask a follow-up when the user asked only for the supporting pages.
positive_examples: Which page proves the NHA relationship for 120-20970-001?
Cite the source page connecting 120-20970-001 to its parent assembly.
Where is this assembly relationship shown in the IPL?
What figure and item support the parent relationship for 42952-10?
Show the source evidence for the direct NHA of 120-34291-001.
negative_examples: Query: How do I install 120-20970-001? | Not an NHA question; route to procedure retrieval.
Query: Find part 120-20970-001. | Exact identifier lookup, not an assembly relationship.
Query: Is 120-20970-001 approved for replacement? | Authority verification, not NHA reasoning.
known_failure_lessons: Never report a grandparent as the direct NHA when an intermediate supported hop exists.
Never collapse multiple parent candidates without project, configuration, effectivity, usage-code, revision, or variant context.
OCR, visual, summary, and Engram guidance cannot prove an NHA relationship without source-supported relationship evidence.

skill_cards.title: NHA project, configuration, revision, and effectivity resolution
skill_cards.description: Keep multiple parent candidates separate until project, configuration, revision, effectivity, usage-code, or variant scope resolves them.
applies_when: Keep multiple parent candidates separate until project, configuration, revision, effectivity, usage-code, or variant scope resolves them.
A real part identifier and an assembly-relationship intent are both present.
does_not_apply_when: The request is only a procedure, exact-location, compatibility, or approval question.
The identifier is reserved synthetic benchmark data in a production request.
skill_cards.reasoning_goal: Compare scoped relationship records and either select the uniquely supported scope-specific parent or explain exactly what scope is missing.
required_first_searches: Resolve all real relationship records for the exact child.
Facet candidate parents by project, configuration, revision, effectivity, usage code, and variant.
Compare only records whose source pages and scope fields are explicit.
forbidden_tunnels: Using Engram atoms or examples as source evidence.
Using the synthetic N5 overlay for a production claim.
Allowing an LLM to invent a parent, child, hierarchy hop, project, revision, or effectivity.
ranking_policy: An exact requested scope match outranks an unscoped relationship.
Do not merge records from different revisions or configurations.
When scope metadata is absent, preserve all credible candidates and ask the smallest discriminating question.

evidence_sufficiency.direct_answer_requires: Exactly one source-supported parent remains after applying the user-supplied scope and its pages are available.
evidence_sufficiency.candidate_mode_when: More than one parent remains, or the source does not state the scope field needed to choose.
evidence_sufficiency.guidance_mode_when: Only OCR, visual, summary, or graph guidance exists without a real source-supported relationship.

answer_mode_rules.direct_if: Exactly one source-supported parent remains after applying the user-supplied scope and its pages are available.
answer_mode_rules.fail_closed_if: No real source-supported relationship and source page are available, or the requested scope remains unresolved.

answer_requirements: Name the applied scope before stating a parent.
List remaining candidates when the scope is incomplete.
State the exact missing scope field that would resolve the conflict.
Never invent project, revision, effectivity, usage code, or configuration values.
follow_up_policy: Ask one high-information scope question at a time.
positive_examples: Does the NHA of 42952-10 change by project?
Which parent applies to configuration A for 120-48023-001?
Compare the parent assembly across revisions for 120-34291-001.
What NHA applies under usage code 001?
I have two parent candidates; which effectivity selects the correct one?

Query: Find part 120-20970-001. | Exact identifier lookup, not an assembly relationship.
Query: Is 120-20970-001 approved for replacement? | Authority verification, not NHA reasoning.
known_failure_lessons: Never report a grandparent as the direct NHA when an intermediate supported hop exists.
Never collapse multiple parent candidates without project, configuration, effectivity, usage-code, revision, or variant context.
OCR, visual, summary, and Engram guidance cannot prove an NHA relationship without source-supported relationship evidence.
